description: Search US importers and global suppliers, load US import/export and Mexico company profiles, or explore an HS code page. Public data only; no ImportYeti account required.

addressContains.description: Optional case-insensitive filter on the company or supplier address, e.g. a state, city, or street keyword.
addressContains.title: Address contains

hsCode.description: For searchByHsCode: 2-10 digits. 2-digit chapters (84) and 4-digit headings (8418) load their page directly; 6+ digit subheadings use the HS search API (e.g. 841810 or 8418.10). 8- and 10-digit HTS codes fall back to the 6-digit subheading when needed.
hsCode.title: HS Code

includeShipments.description: Add one record per recent bill of lading with recordType=shipment. US import profiles expose up to 100 recent BOLs (two 50-row views merged by BOL); US export and Mexico profiles expose up to 50. In search modes this costs one extra profile request per company.
includeShipments.sectionDescription: Optional filters and shipment rows. All fields are omit-empty.
includeShipments.title: Include shipment rows

maxItems.description: Maximum number of dataset records across companies, HS summaries, and shipment rows.
maxItems.title: Max Records

mode.description: What to do. Search by keyword, load specific company/supplier profiles, or explore an HS code.
enumTitles: Search US importers by company or product keyword
Search global suppliers by company name
Load company/supplier profiles from URLs or slugs (US import, US export, Mexico)
Search companies and suppliers by HS code
mode.title: Mode

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. ImportYeti allows about 25 requests per IP before a login wall; Apify Proxy AUTO (included in the plan) rotates exit IPs. No residential proxy is required.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: AUTO datacenter proxy is enough. Leave the default for cloud runs.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

query.description: Company name or product keyword for searchImporters/searchSuppliers. Optional in companyProfile (a profile URL here is used when startUrls is empty) and in searchByHsCode (a numeric HS code here is used when hsCode is empty).
query.title: Search Query

since.description: Optional recency filter, YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY. Applies to shipment dates and to a company's most recent shipment date. Records without a date are excluded when this is set.
since.title: Only on/after date

startUrls.description: For companyProfile: ImportYeti profile URLs or paths. Accepts company/..., supplier/..., us-export/company/..., mx/company/..., and mx/supplier/... (e.g. https://www.importyeti.com/company/samsung-electronics-america or supplier/foxconn). Bare slugs are treated as US company profiles.

url.description: ImportYeti company or supplier profile URL.
url.title: Profile URL

startUrls.title: Company / Supplier URLs

title: ImportYeti Trade, Supplier & Shipment Data Scraper Input
